Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The MiddleEasternHistory_Expert made a mistake by identifying the Prime Minister of Iran in April 1977 as Amir-Abbas Hoveyda. Although Hoveyda was indeed a prominent political figure in Iran, he was not the Prime Minister in April 1977. In fact, he was arrested in 1977, and Jamshid Amouzegar was the Prime Minister of Iran at that time. The mistake led to an incorrect solution to the problem.
